The Bike Line Tuesday & Thursday Road Ride

Indianapolis, IN · Broad Ripple · Road

The Bike Line Tuesday & Thursday Road Ride is a road group ride in Indianapolis, IN. It rolls tuesdays and Thursdays at 7:00 pm from The Bike Line, Broad Ripple. About 22 miles, fast group ~23 mph, slower group ~18 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 23 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at @bikelineindiana the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Bike Line Tuesday & Thursday Road Ride group ride

A marked ~22 mile road route from the Broad Ripple shop. Not a no-drop ride, but it usually splits into a fast group and a more leisurely one.
